simple.meaning: זֹה (zôh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “this or that.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Judges 18:4. The surrounding context includes family line, covenant, priesthood, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זֹה (H2090) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: זֹה (zôh) / H2090 is traced through Judges 18:4, 2 Samuel 11:25, 1 Kings 14:5, 2 Kings 6:19 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: He said to them, “Thus and thus has Micah dealt with me, and he has hired me, and I have become his priest.”

Then David said to the messenger, “Tell Joab, ‘Don’t let this thing displease you, for the sword devours one as well as another. Make your battle stronger against the city, and overthrow it.’ Encourage him.”

Yahweh said to Ahijah, “Behold, Jeroboam’s wife is coming to inquire of you concerning her son; for he is sick. Tell her such and such; for it will be, when she comes in, that she will pretend to be another woman.”
Elisha said to them, “This is not the way, neither is this the city. Follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom you seek.” He led them to Samaria.
If your children will keep my covenant,
I said of laughter, “It is foolishness;” and of mirth, “What does it accomplish?”
There is nothing better for a man than that he should eat and drink, and make his soul enjoy good in his labor. This also I saw, that it is from the hand of God.
As he came out of his mother’s womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he may carry away in his hand.

Behold, that which I have seen to be good and proper is for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy good in all his labor, in which he labors under the sun, all the days of his life which God has given him; for this is his portion.
All this I have proved in wisdom. I said, “I will be wise;” but it was far from me.
I have also seen wisdom under the sun in this way, and it seemed great to me.
He said to me, “This room, which faces toward the south, is for the priests, the keepers of the duty of the house.

definitions.usage: as well as another, it, this, that, thus and thus.
definitions.full: H2090. zoh זֹה this (feminine) = זֹאת (compare זוֺ , in Mishna the regular feminine of זֶה ) — 2Kin 6:19 ; Ezek 40:45 ; Eccl 2:2 , 24 ; 5:15 ; 5:18 ; 7:23 ; 9:13 ( זאת does not occur in Ecclesiastes); also in the phrase וְכָזֶה כָּזֹה (see זה 6c β ).
